import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 取消培元丹效果
 * 指令：/取消培元丹
 */
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/peiyuanDan/cancel/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const result = await App({ bid: String(e.UserId), uid: Number(e.uid), request });

  if (result.code === 'INVALID_USER') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('未找到用户信息，请先踏入仙途');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (result.code === 'CANCEL_FAILED') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, result.uid, '取消培元丹', `❤ ${result.message}`, request);

    md.addText(failMsg);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText('⚠️ 培元丹效果已取消');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(result.data.message);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '',
      content: md,
      footer: [
        { label: '查看属性', command: '/属性面板' },
        { label: '继续服用', command: '/服用 培元丹 1' }
      ]
    })
  );
});
